children.description: Habitat and ecology. Rochefortia barloventensis sp. nov. grows at low altitudes (sea level up to 125 m). It is found in arid coast lines, wooded hillsides, in thickets, mesophyll forests and coastal xerophytic forests. Phenology. Collected in flower: April – May, July, September – October, December; in fruit: May – June, December – January.
